env.name: GITHUB
env.label: GitHub
env.hint: Sign in as a maintainer who can read the repository: it reads releases with that access. Public repositories need none

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.label: Or a GitHub token
env.hint: Instead of signing in: a fine-grained token, the release's repositories, Contents read-only

env.name: GITHUB_APP_ID
env.label: Or your own GitHub App's ID

env.name: GITHUB_APP_KEY
env.label: Its private key (.pem)
env.hint: Weave signs with it for the service; the service never sees it
